Description: Changes affecting the entire regulatory document or act, including full revisions or the introduction/removal of complete documents.

Changes affecting structured elements within a document, such as articles, sections, chapters, annexes, paragraphs, points, or items, where the main effect is the creation, deletion, renumbering, reorganization, or substantive modification of that structural unit.

Fine-grained changes within existing provisions, including modifications to sentences, phrases, or wording that alter the expression or interpretation of requirements, where the main effect is not a reference update.
Changes where the main regulatory effect is the creation, deletion, or update of a citation or cross-reference to another provision inside the same document.

Changes where the main regulatory effect is the creation, deletion, or update of a citation or reference to an external legal act, regulation, directive, guideline, standard, framework, authority document, or other instrument outside the same document.
New text, articles, provisions, references, requirements, or complete documents introduced.
Existing text, provisions, references, requirements, or complete documents removed or repealed.
Existing text, provisions, references, requirements, or structural elements modified or revised.
Changes to definitions, actors, roles, entities, concepts, scope of application, terminology, or locations.
Changes affecting required actions, constraints, permissions, prohibitions, reporting/disclosure duties, governance expectations, control requirements, or expected behaviours.
Changes to deadlines, dates, frequencies, transitional periods, application dates, compliance windows, reporting periods, or time limits.

Changes mainly affecting governance, policies, processes, workflows, documentation, reporting, disclosure, communication, registration, approvals, evidence retention, responsibilities, legal or administrative handling, compliance steps, or organizational arrangements.

Changes directly affecting ICT systems, security controls, technical safeguards, infrastructure, software, hardware, networks, encryption, authentication mechanisms, access-control mechanisms, logging/monitoring tools, vulnerability management, incident-detection systems, backup/recovery mechanisms, testing methods, or other implementation mechanisms. Do not use technical merely because the document concerns ICT, cybersecurity, digital operational resilience, payment systems, or technical standards.
